scope: Native ordinary-user bot directory/install and owned bot/OAuth management

webEvidence.boundary: Official Windows Electron app loads the website; these website bundles contain the remotely served feature implementation.

implemented: Native bot directory query/category/sort, profile-backed detail and visible commands.
Installation lists authoritative bot_add_targets and freshly rechecks selection before bot_add_to_server; never synthesizes management permissions.
Own bots table is owner_id=current user scoped. Bot create/edit/delete/token rotation/sharing/publication/private review and webhook management use the observed endpoints.
Bot description and icon updates preserve unrelated fields; unchanged bot names are omitted from edits to avoid the weekly rename operation.
Owned bot profile text,4MiB native multipart image upload/removal, bot server list/removal and registered commands.
Owned bot activity registration/edit/removal; actual execution of website activities is not claimed native.
Owned OAuth app list/create/update/remove, exact redirect validation, scanned app icons and explicit confirmed client-secret rotation.
Tokens/secrets remain ephemeral view state and are hidden when the app becomes inactive; explicit copy uses local-only expiring clipboard.
DEBUG fixture mode avoids all network requests and account writes.
knownLimits: No hosting control, paid hosting checkout, promotions or advertising accounting is included in this checkpoint.
Directory promotion impressions/click tracking and paid ordering are not reproduced.
Bot verification progress checklist is not yet rendered; publication/review actions use actual backend state.
Directory support invite preview/deep-link and arbitrary bot share links are not yet integrated.
OAuth authorization endpoint execution/SDK sample generation is not a native application login provider; managing owned apps does not claim support for arbitrary OAuth redirect interception.
No real bot, app, installation, secret rotation, report or uploaded image was created by the agent.
Full application feature parity remains false; runtime permissions and account-specific backend behavior require human review.
